### Public Key Generation
```python
A = np.array([[1, 6, 6, 2], [6, 0, 5, 3], [2, 5, 4, 1]])
s = np.array([3, 4, 0, 6])
e = np.array([0, -1, 1])
p = 7

b = generate_public_key_vector(A, s, e, p)
assert np.array_equal(b, np.array([4, 0, 5]))
```

### Encryption
```python
public_key = (A, np.array([4, 0, 5]))
random_vector = np.array([1, 0, 1])

u0, v0 = encrypt(public_key, random_vector, 0, 7)
assert np.array_equal(u0, np.array([3, 4, 3, 3]))
assert v0 == 2

u1, v1 = encrypt(public_key, random_vector, 1, 7)
assert np.array_equal(u1, np.array([3, 4, 3, 3]))
assert v1 == 5
```

### Decryption
```python
s = np.array([3, 4, 0, 6])

msg0 = decrypt(s, (np.array([3, 4, 3, 3]), 2), 7)
assert msg0 == 0

msg1 = decrypt(s, (np.array([3, 4, 3, 3]), 5), 7)
assert msg1 == 1
```
